report:
rg-history (responsible gaming + player history) is built against the real API. The final checks pass:
- web typecheck, lint and test (95 tests);
- the flock'ed production build (`NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-rg-history`, EXIT=0);
- 40 Playwright screenshots (20 screens × 1440/390) with no horizontal overflow and no console errors;
- the new e2e spec `apps/web/e2e/rg-history.spec.ts` (4/4);
- API typecheck and lint (exit 0) and my API tests (14 new e2e + 9 new unit).

The full API suite has one failure, in `test/admin.e2e-spec.ts` ("flagged withdrawals need FOUR EYES": the admin withdrawal queue does not contain the new withdrawal). It looks unrelated to my changes but I did not confirm the cause.

**API (`apps/api`)**
- **Responsible gaming** (`src/modules/compliance/responsible-gaming.service.ts` + controller):
  - Limits: removing one waits 24 h; pending increases or removals can be cancelled; each limit has a `resetsAt`.
  - Session tracking from heartbeats; a session ends after 15 min without activity (`rg-session.ts`, pure and unit-tested).
  - Time rules, enforced server-side in `assertCanParticipate`, return 422 `RG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`:
    - daily time limit;
    - session-length limit (raising or removing it waits 24 h);
    - quiet hours (turning them off waits 24 h).
  - Reality checks: pause and push toggles; replies are logged as continue / history / break.
  - `POST /responsible-gaming/cooling-off` (24h/7d/30d).
  - Self-exclusion: new `5y` option. 6m/1y/5y/permanent need the typed phrase `SELF-EXCLUDE` plus an acknowledgement, and a step-up TOTP code when 2FA is on.
  - An active break or exclusion can be extended but never shortened (409).
  - The effective exclusion is the one that ends last.
  - Limit history comes from the hash-chained audit log.
  - Breaks and exclusions block entries and deposits (403 `SELF_EXCLUDED` with `kind`). Withdrawals and history stay open.
- **New `history` module**, `/history/*`:
  - `summary`, `transactions` (several types at once plus search), `transactions/export` (CSV, with formula-injection protection, audited);
  - `fees`, `entries` (grouped by round, with odds share), `rounds/active`, `rounds/results`, `winnings` (owed vs settled);
  - `games` (Global Pool and simulation totals kept separate), `game-rounds` (+ export);
  - `favourites` (GET/PUT/DELETE).
- **Prisma:** additive migration `20261128140000_rg_history` (new columns on `rg_settings` and `rg_limits`, new table `user_favourite_games`).
- **Shared (`@gp/shared`), additive:** `schemas/rg.ts` extended, new `schemas/history.ts`, `5y` plus cooling-off and long-exclusion helpers in `enums.ts`, RG constants in `limits.ts`.
- **DEMO data:** idempotent script `prisma/seed-history-demo.ts` adds simulation game sessions for @nova.k (seeds verifiable with the Pool Dice scheme) and favourites. It never touches the ledger, and it has been run on the dev DB.
- **Docs:** `docs/API.md` lists the new endpoints.

**Web (`apps/web`)**
- `src/lib/api/rg-history.ts`: wrappers and TanStack hooks, all through `apiRequest`.
- `src/components/rg-history/*`:
  - page shell with breadcrumb, desktop tabs and mobile pills;
  - `LimitSetter`, `SessionBar`, `HelpResources` (real help organisations), PGSI self-check;
  - `RealityCheckHost` and `RealityCheckCard`; `ExportDialog`; desktop table and mobile cards;
  - RG1–RG7, F1–F6 and G1–G7 screens with loading, empty, error, guest, pending, active and confirm states. Confirmations are a dialog at ≥768 px and a bottom sheet below that.
- Routes:
  - `/responsible-gaming/*` and `/history/*`;
  - `/history` redirects to `/history/transactions`;
  - added redirects for the sidebar links `/transactions`, `/favourites` and `/recently-played` to my pages (they were 404).
- **Reality check, app-wide:** `RealityCheckHost` is mounted in `app/(app)/layout.tsx` (additive edit).
  - Only active with `NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE=api`.
  - Heartbeats only count real play: a visible tab on `/pool`, `/games`, `/casino` or `/originals` with input in the last 90 s. Idle agent or QA tabs therefore do not build up sessions.
  - The reminder opens on any page when the server says it is due, at the configured interval.
  - No close icon, Escape and outside clicks do nothing, and focus lands on the panel so no choice looks pre-selected.
- Tests and QA: `test/rg-history.test.ts`, `e2e/rg-history.spec.ts`, `scripts/rg-history-qa.mjs`; `docs/WEB_COMPONENTS.md` has a new section.
- Small shared fixes:
  - root `eslint.config.mjs` now ignores `**/.next-*/**` (otherwise `eslint .` linted per-agent build output);
  - `apps/web/tsconfig.json` now includes `e2e/**/*.ts` and `playwright.config.ts` (`web lint` failed without them).

**Ledger status**
- **Implemented and verified** (1440 + 390 screenshots against the live API, compared with the Figma frames): USR-RG1, RG2, RG3, RG4, RG5, RG6, USR-F1–F6, USR-G1–G7, MOB-10.
- **USR-RG7: PARTIAL.** The 4 steps work end to end, with two departures from Figma:
  - Step 3 uses an authenticator code (only when 2FA is on) instead of a password, because Privy players have no password.
  - Step 2 says open entries stay in their round, where the design says they are refunded.
- **Shell-level items not done (RG6/RG7):** "Deposit disabled in the top bar" and "sidebar promos hidden" while excluded. The shared shell has no hook for this. The API still blocks deposits and hides deposit addresses.
- **Other gaps:**
  - Figma's G2 per-entry expandable rows: I group by round instead.
  - F6 "Your exports" list (exports are only recorded in the audit log).
  - Push notifications for reality checks: the toggle is stored but nothing sends them.
  - Quiet hours are in UTC, not the player's local time.

**Figma:** 6 screenshots saved in `design/reference/rg-history/` (RG1 1440 and 390, RG2 pending, RG7 step 1, F6, G2). Several calls hit the seat rate limit; the rest of the copy came from the build scripts in `design/figma-build/queue/usr-rg` and `pending/usr-finance` / `usr-gaming`.

**Environment notes**
- I applied the pending, additive `20261128160500_onchain_mirror` migration from api-gaps to the shared dev DB. Without it every round query failed, because the shared Prisma client already expected those columns.
- All my servers are stopped (API 4103, web 3103) and `.next-rg-history` and `.dev/dist-rg-history` are removed. All my files were already in your WIP commit `43dd670`.
- Writes during QA (limit changes, breaks, self-exclusions) only touched throwaway users, never @nova.k.

**Memory:** nothing was used beyond the existing GLOBAL POOL Figma note. One thing possibly worth saving (seen this session): sibling subagents share the same scratchpad directory, so file names there can collide (admin-a overwrote one of my log files).

decisions: Privy players have no password: long self-exclusion (6m/1y/5y/permanent) is confirmed with the typed phrase SELF-EXCLUDE + an unchecked acknowledgement, plus a step-up TOTP code (purpose security_settings) only when 2FA is on. Open entries are NOT refunded on self-exclusion or cooling-off: they stay in their round (committed on-chain) and any prize is credited and withdrawable. Figma RG7 says 'refunded per round rules'. Business decision for the owner.

Play time = activity heartbeats from a visible tab on /pool, /games, /casino, /originals with input in the last 90 s; a session ends after 15 min idle. Browsing account/history pages does not count. This also keeps other agents' automated QA tabs from building up sessions.

Quiet hours are in UTC. While they are on, the times can only change by turning them off (24 h) and on again.
An active break or self-exclusion can be extended but never shortened (409). Self-exclusion while on a break is allowed because it is longer.

report:
I closed the backend gaps for api-gaps, except one: RG session time and reality checks. The rg-history agent claimed those in coordination task #50, so I did not build them. Everything else is done and green:
- API typecheck, lint and build pass.
- API tests: 14 unit files / 59 tests and 13 e2e files / 99 tests, including the new Anvil chain suite.
- @gp/contracts and @gp/shared typecheck, lint and test pass.

Nothing is committed. Every server I started is stopped (checked by PID).

**1. On-chain round mirroring** (`apps/api/src/modules/onchain-rounds/`).
- `RoundMirrorService` runs the round on the contract with viem and the `@gp/contracts` ABI:
  - `openRound` publishes the rules and a hash of the canonical rules document.
  - `commitEntries` commits a Merkle root over salted entry commitments. Each entry gets a random 32-byte salt, stored encrypted in the append-only `entry_commitments` table.
  - When the contract says the thresholds are missed, the keeper sends `cancelRound` and the stakes go back to Owed.
  - Otherwise the keeper sends `requestDraw`.
  - `ChainlinkVrfProvider` watches for `DrawFulfilled` and waits for confirmations.
  - Before any prize is credited, the database winners and amounts must equal the contract's `computeWinners()` and `prizeAmounts()`. If they differ, settlement is blocked and an ALERT is logged.
  - After settlement, `recordSettlement` publishes the payouts root. The payout leaves and proofs are stored in the append-only `round_payouts` table.
  - A draw unfulfilled for 24 hours is re-requested, never cancelled, and audited.
- Every step is idempotent: the contract's state decides whether a step is already done.
- New read-only endpoints: `GET /pool/rounds/:n/chain`, `/manifest`, `/payouts`, and `/my-proofs` (player only; returns their own salts and proofs).
- Shared signer (`apps/api/src/modules/blockchain/chain-signer.service.ts`): checks `eth_chainId` before signing (only 421614 or 31337; 31337 is refused in production), simulates the call and decodes custom errors, and manages nonces in the database. Each transaction is signed and stored in a `chain_transactions` outbox before broadcast, re-broadcast byte-for-byte, and tracked as mined, reverted or dropped.
- Keys come from env and are generated at runtime in tests. I checked that the smoke API log contains no keys.
- The lifecycle e2e on a fresh Anvil proves DB winners == contract winners and prizes == `prizeAmounts`. Every payout passes `verifyPayout` and the owner's receipts pass `verifyEntry`.
- A unit test rebuilds the contract fixture's 18,640-entry root and its payouts root exactly.

**2. Deposit watcher** (`deposit-chain-watcher.service.ts`).
- Scans `Transfer` logs from a mock ERC-20 and credits PENDING → AVAILABLE after N confirmations.
- Idempotent by `txHash` + `logIndex`.
- Re-org safe:
  - Unconfirmed deposits are re-checked through their receipts on every pass.
  - Each scan re-reads the last N blocks.
  - A transaction re-included in another block is followed and credited once.
  - A transaction that stays missing for N more blocks, or that reverted, is reversed with a new `deposit_reversed` posting (PENDING → CHAIN_CLEARING).
- All of this is e2e-tested with Anvil snapshot/revert.

**3. Withdrawal broadcaster** (`withdrawal-broadcaster.service.ts`).
- Flow: queued → liquidity check → simulate → sign and store in the outbox, moving the withdrawal to broadcast in the same DB transaction → broadcast → tracker job → confirmed and settled in the ledger.
- Reverted or dropped → failed, and the funds go back to Available.
- A transfer whose simulation reverts never gets a nonce. It fails straight from queued, and the funds go back.
- Missing hot-wallet liquidity, or an RPC that cannot be reached, keeps the withdrawal queued and retries it.
- e2e tests cover confirmation with the exact net amount on-chain, consecutive nonces under concurrent sends, the simulation revert, and a real on-chain revert.

**4. Email, socket.io and OpenAPI.**
- Email adapter (`apps/api/src/modules/email/`):
  - Transports: `log` (dev console), SMTP via nodemailer, or disabled.
  - Delivery: a BullMQ `emails` worker.
  - Content: every email carries the DEMO notice and the anti-phishing code.
  - Preferences: honours the A9 notification preferences; locked security categories always send.
  - Tests: e2e against the console transport and an in-process fake SMTP server.
- socket.io Redis adapter (`SOCKET_IO_REDIS_ADAPTER`): an e2e test proves an event raised on replica A reaches a client on replica B.
- OpenAPI response schemas: 19 main operations now have schemas, and every operation gets a `default` error-envelope response. A contract e2e test parses live responses with the same schemas.

**5. Docker compose.**
- `docker compose --profile dev`: `api-dev` runs with `NODE_ENV=development`, so the DEV MOCK player login works. It runs migrations and the DEMO seed on start, with jobs and console mail on, plus `web-dev`.
- `--profile prod` runs production mode, where the DEV MOCK is refused.
- The Dockerfile now installs OpenSSL for Prisma.
- `.dockerignore` now excludes nested `.dev` folders. Before this, `apps/api/.dev` (the DEMO admin credentials) would have been copied into the image.
- `docker compose config` validates both profiles. The images were not built because there is no Docker daemon.

Docs are updated in `docs/API.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/CONTRACTS.md` and the contracts README.

**Known limits:**
- The mirror and broadcaster are proven on Anvil only. Nothing is deployed on Arbitrum Sepolia and there is no VRF subscription yet.
- Signer keys come from env, not a KMS.
- A stuck withdrawal is only re-broadcast as-is; there is no speed-up or cancel transaction yet.
- There is no Redis throttler store yet.

Main files are under `/home/user/Claude/global-pool/apps/api/src/modules/{onchain-rounds,blockchain,email}/`, `/home/user/Claude/global-pool/apps/api/src/modules/deposits/deposit-chain-watcher.service.ts`, `/home/user/Claude/global-pool/apps/api/src/modules/withdrawals/withdrawal-broadcaster.service.ts`, `/home/user/Claude/global-pool/apps/api/src/infra/openapi/response-schemas.ts` and `/home/user/Claude/global-pool/apps/api/test/{anvil,chain.e2e-spec,infra.e2e-spec,openapi.e2e-spec,devnet}.ts`.

**Notes from this session the main session may want to save** (learned here; nothing in memory applied to this task):
- The Chainlink VRF v2.5 mock's subscription id depends on the block hash, so read it from the `SubscriptionCreated` event, not from a simulated call.
- viem caches `getBlockNumber`, which under-counts confirmations on an on-demand Anvil; use `cacheTime: 0` there.
- The 18,640-entry tree test needs more than vitest's 5 s default timeout when the suite runs in parallel.
- `pkill -f` is blocked in this sandbox because it could hit other agents' servers; kill your own processes by PID instead.
